description: Core of op-sr4n. Add a private ActivePaper (wraps crate::session::PaperSession + the paper's resolved absolute source-PDF path, from EntityConfig::load(root.paper_dir(citekey)).source.pdf) and a DigitiseApp::activate_paper(citekey) -> Result<(), String> that opens the session, pushes the PDF into pdf_reader.open(), and loads the markdown into kvim_editor.load_text(). Does not touch bibliography.rs/markdown_editor.rs (separate beads -- they speak the older crate::project format).

description:
The four solver binaries in outram-foam-cli/src/bin (pimple_foam, rho_central_foam, rho_pimple_foam, sonic_foam) each carry a private run(), control_from_case(), time_span(), find_scalar()/find_vector() and fmt_time(). That is the case-driving glue -- FoamCase dir -> ControlDict -> configured solver -> time loop -> write fields -- duplicated four ways and reusable from nowhere. src/lib.rs is 111 lines of arg parsing only.

Lift it into a library API (run_case-style) so the same path is callable from Rust and, via the outram-park Python wheel, from Python. The binaries become thin wrappers; the solvers themselves already exist as libs in outram-foam-appbuilder-lib/src/solvers and need no porting. Examples and tutorials stay as they are -- they already consume the lib solvers.

Related: outram-park (parent repo) gh:#3 covers the pyo3 generator gaps that block any of this from reaching Python.
title: outram-foam: lift the CLI case-driving glue into a reusable lib API
